project: Fit with Jade - Complete Meal Guide

meals.name: Banana Wrap
method: Slice banana into rounds.
Spread honey evenly across the wrap.
Lay banana slices down the centre of the wrap, roll up and slice in half to serve.

meals.name: Muffin PB and J
method: Split and toast the English muffins until golden.
Spread peanut butter on one half and jam on the other.
Sandwich together and serve warm.

meals.name: Cereal
method: Add Cocopops to a bowl.
Slice banana over the top.
Pour over almond milk to taste.

meals.name: Crumpets
method: Toast crumpets until golden and crisp at the edges.
Spread jam evenly across the warm crumpets and serve.

meals.name: Overnight Oats Chia — Apple Walnut
method: Combine oats, protein powder and chia seeds in a glass tub or jar.
Mix with water (or milk) to a thick porridge consistency. Stir again after 10 minutes.
Fold through diced apple and chopped walnuts.
Set in the fridge for 2 hours or overnight to thicken.

meals.name: Overnight Oats Chia — Strawberry Choc
method: Combine oats, protein powder and chia seeds in a glass tub or jar.
Mix with water (or milk) to a thick porridge consistency. Stir again after 10 minutes.
Stir in cocoa powder. Top with strawberries and chopped chocolate before setting.
Set in the fridge for 2 hours or overnight to thicken.

meals.name: Overnight Oats Chia — Mango
method: Combine oats, protein powder and chia seeds in a glass tub or jar.
Mix with water (or milk) to a thick porridge consistency. Stir again after 10 minutes.
Top with mango and a generous sprinkle of shredded coconut.
Set in the fridge for 2 hours or overnight to thicken.

meals.name: Overnight Oats Chia — Choc Berry
method: Combine oats, protein powder and chia seeds in a glass tub or jar.
Mix with water (or milk) to a thick porridge consistency. Stir again after 10 minutes.
Top with blueberries and a drizzle of Mayver's hazelnut cashew cacao spread.
Set in the fridge for 2 hours or overnight to thicken.

meals.name: Overnight Oats Chia — Banana PB
method: Combine oats, protein powder and chia seeds in a glass tub or jar.
Mix with water (or milk) to a thick porridge consistency. Stir again after 10 minutes.
Fold through sliced banana and a swirl of peanut butter.
Set in the fridge for 2 hours or overnight to thicken.

meals.name: Overnight Oats Chia — Apple Crumble
method: Combine oats, protein powder and chia seeds in a glass tub or jar.
Mix with water (or milk) to a thick porridge consistency. Stir again after 10 minutes.
Top with warmed canned apple (or pears), crumbled Biscoff biscuits and a drizzle of caramel syrup.
Set in the fridge for 2 hours or overnight to thicken.

meals.name: Overnight Oats Chia — White Choc Raspberry

ingredients.name: Noshu sugar free white choc chips

method: Combine oats, protein powder and chia seeds in a glass tub or jar.
Mix with water (or milk) to a thick porridge consistency. Stir again after 10 minutes.
Fold through raspberries and Noshu sugar-free white choc chips.
Set in the fridge for 2 hours or overnight to thicken.

meals.name: Overnight Oats Chia — Carrot Walnut
method: Combine oats, protein powder and chia seeds in a glass tub or jar.
Mix with water (or milk) to a thick porridge consistency. Stir again after 10 minutes.
Fold through grated carrot and chopped walnuts. Drizzle with caramel syrup.
Set in the fridge for 2 hours or overnight to thicken.

meals.name: Brekky Bagel — Cheesy Bacon and Egg
method: Slice and toast the Abe's bagel.
Cook bacon in a hot pan until crisp, then fry the egg to your liking.
Layer cheese, bacon and egg between the bagel halves. Drizzle with BBQ sauce.

meals.name: Brekky Bagel — Salmon Cream Cheese
method: Slice and toast the Abe's bagel.
Spread light cream cheese on both halves of the bagel.
Layer smoked salmon on top and sandwich together.

meals.name: Brekky Bagel — Creamy Nutella
method: Slice and toast the Abe's bagel.
Mix whey protein into Yopro yoghurt until smooth and creamy.
Spread Mayver's protein choc PB on one half and the creamy yoghurt mix on the other. Sandwich together.

meals.name: Brekky Bagel — Avo Cottage Cheese
method: Slice and toast the Abe's bagel.
Mash cottage cheese with avocado until smooth.
Spread on the bagel and layer sliced cooked chicken on top.

meals.name: Brekky Bagel — Strawberry Ricotta
method: Slice and toast the Abe's bagel.
Mix whey protein into ricotta until creamy and smooth.
Spread ricotta on one half and jam on the other. Sandwich together.

meals.name: Fudgy Pumpkin Brownie
method: Steam or microwave pumpkin until very soft. Mash and allow to cool.
Stir in egg, cocoa powder, protein powder, baking powder, almond butter and sugar-free maple syrup.
Fold through chopped dark chocolate.
Pour into a lined glass tub and bake at 180°C for 20-25 minutes until set but still fudgy.
Top with Chobani light to serve.

meals.name: Apple Muffin
method: Mix rolled oats, protein powder, baking powder, honey and almond butter in a bowl.
Add cold water in dashes until you reach a cake batter consistency.
Fold through diced apple.
Microwave 2-4 minutes, or bake at 180°C for 20-30 minutes until cooked through.
Top with Chobani light and chopped walnuts.

meals.name: Yoghurt Bowl (Chobani) — Choc Banana
method: Mix protein powder into Chobani light until smooth.
Sprinkle rice bubbles across the top.
Slice banana over the top and drizzle with Mayver's hazelnut cashew cacao spread.

meals.name: Yoghurt Bowl (Chobani) — Mango Coconut
method: Mix protein powder into Chobani light until smooth.
Sprinkle rice bubbles across the top.
Top with mango, drizzle with honey and sprinkle with shredded coconut.

meals.name: Yoghurt Bowl (Chobani) — Banana Caramel
method: Mix protein powder into Chobani light until smooth.
Sprinkle rice bubbles across the top.
Slice banana over the top, sprinkle with chopped peanuts and drizzle with caramel syrup.

meals.name: Yoghurt Bowl (Chobani) — Choc Berry Coconut
method: Mix protein powder into Chobani light until smooth.
Sprinkle rice bubbles across the top.
Top with sliced strawberries, chopped dark chocolate and a sprinkle of shredded coconut.

meals.name: Yoghurt Bowl (Chobani) — Apple Crumble
method: Mix protein powder into Chobani light until smooth.
Sprinkle rice bubbles across the top.
Warm canned apple briefly, spoon over the yoghurt and crumble Biscoff biscuits on top.
Drizzle with Biscoff spread to finish.

meals.name: Yoghurt Bowl (Chobani) — Milo
method: Mix protein powder into Chobani light until smooth.
Sprinkle rice bubbles across the top.
Slice banana over the top and sprinkle generously with Milo powder.

meals.name: Yoghurt Bowl (Chobani) — Pear and Walnut
method: Mix protein powder into Chobani light until smooth.
Sprinkle rice bubbles across the top.
Top with drained canned pear and chopped walnuts.
Drizzle with sugar-free caramel syrup.

meals.name: Yoghurt Bowl (Chobani) — Snickers
method: Mix protein powder into Chobani light until smooth.
Sprinkle rice bubbles across the top.
Chop dates, chocolate and peanuts small. Sprinkle over the yoghurt.
Drizzle with sugar-free caramel syrup.

meals.name: Chia Pudding — Banana PB Honey
method: Combine chia seeds, almond milk and protein powder in a jar or glass tub.
Mix well, then give another stir after 10 minutes of settling.
Set in the fridge for 2 hours or overnight to thicken.
Top with sliced banana, peanut butter and a drizzle of honey — or fold all toppings in before setting for simplicity.

meals.name: Protein Oats — Choc Berry
method: Cover oats with water in a microwave-safe bowl and microwave for 90 seconds.
Stir in protein powder until smooth, adding a dash of water if needed.
Top with sliced strawberries and chopped dark chocolate.

meals.name: Protein Oats — Carrot Cake
method: Cover oats with water in a microwave-safe bowl and microwave for 90 seconds.
Stir in protein powder until smooth, adding a dash of water if needed.
Top with grated carrot, chopped walnuts, a drizzle of honey and sugar-free caramel syrup.
Sprinkle with cinnamon and nutmeg to finish.

meals.name: Baked Oats — Carrot Cake
method: Blend oats into a flour, then combine with protein powder, grated carrot, baking powder, cinnamon, nutmeg and ginger in a bowl.
Stir in almond milk until you reach a thick cake batter consistency.
Bake in a tray, individual glass tubs or muffin cases at 180°C for 25-30 minutes.
Mix Chobani light with cream cheese and sugar-free maple syrup for a creamy topping.
Once cooled, top with the cream cheese mix and chopped walnuts. Slice and divide for the week.

meals.name: Pancake Bowl Bake
method: Mix oat flour, protein powder, egg, baking powder and almond milk to a pancake batter.
Microwave for 3 minutes, or bake in a glass tub at 180°C for 20-25 minutes until cooked through.
Top with chopped dark chocolate, mixed berries and Yopro yoghurt — or fold the chocolate and berries through the batter before cooking.

meals.name: Yoghurt Bowl — Snickers
method: Spoon Yopro into a bowl.
Chop dates, chocolate and peanuts small.
Sprinkle dates, chocolate and peanuts over the yoghurt and drizzle with Natvia caramel sauce.

meals.name: Yoghurt Bowl (Milo Cereal)
method: Spoon Yopro into a bowl.
Slice banana over the top and add a dollop of nut butter.
Sprinkle Milo cereal across the top with mixed berries.

meals.name: Smoothie — Tropical
method: Combine frozen pineapple, frozen mango, banana, protein powder, coconut water and coconut yoghurt in a blender.
Blend until smooth, adding water if needed for desired consistency.

meals.name: Smoothie — Date Banana
method: Combine frozen banana, dates, protein powder, peanut butter and a pinch of cinnamon in a blender.
Add water and blend until smooth and creamy.

meals.name: Protein Cake — Banana Choc
method: Mash banana in a bowl. Stir in protein powder, oat flour and baking powder.
Add almond milk in dashes until you reach a cake batter consistency.
Pour into individual glass tubs or muffin cases. Optionally fold chopped chocolate through the batter or reserve for garnish.
Microwave for 2-3 minutes, or bake at 180°C for 20 minutes.
Top with smoothed Chobani yoghurt and the remaining chopped chocolate.

meals.name: Rice Flour Protein Cake — Berry Coconut

ingredients.name: Sugar free strawberry or choc syrup (Queens)

method: Cover rice flour with double the volume of boiling water, stirring quickly to avoid clumping. It should absorb into a paste.
Stir in protein powder, baking powder and cold water in dashes until you reach a thick cake batter consistency.
Fold through 50g of strawberries (or raspberries).
Microwave 2-4 minutes, or bake at 180°C for 20-30 minutes.
Top with Yopro yoghurt, a drizzle of sugar-free syrup, chopped dark chocolate, additional berries and a sprinkle of shredded coconut.

meals.name: Rice Flour Cake — Apple
method: Cover rice flour with double the volume of boiling water, stirring quickly to avoid clumping. It should absorb into a paste.
Stir in protein powder, baking powder and cold water in dashes until you reach a thick cake batter consistency.
Fold through diced apple and chopped walnuts.
Microwave 2-4 minutes, or bake at 180°C for 20-30 minutes.
Top with Yopro yoghurt and a drizzle of sugar-free caramel syrup.

meals.name: Frittata Bake / Muffins
method: Whisk eggs in a bowl. Stir in diced ham, grated cheese and finely chopped mushroom, tomato, onion and spinach.
Season with paprika, oregano and pepper.
Optional 'quiche' base: press a Simpson's pantry low carb wrap into a greased glass tub before pouring in the egg mixture.
Bake at 180°C for 20-25 minutes until golden and set. Alternatively, divide into muffin cases for individual portions.

meals.name: Salmon Muffin
method: Split and toast the English muffins.
Spread cottage cheese on the warm muffins.
Layer smoked salmon on top with rocket, sliced tomato, spring onion and chives.

meals.name: Shakshuka
method: Heat a sprayed pan over medium heat. Cook red onion, capsicum, mushroom and zucchini until softened.
Stir in diced tomatoes, tomato paste, paprika, cumin, chilli, salt and pepper. Simmer for 5 minutes.
Make three wells in the sauce and crack eggs into them.
Cook until the edges of the eggs turn white, then cover and simmer until eggs are just set.
Top with crumbled feta and parsley. Serve with toasted sourdough bread.

meals.name: Mexican Egg Breakfast Bake

ingredients.name: Sweet potato
ingredients.note: raw weight; grated or mashed base layer

method: Grate or mash sweet potato and press into the base of a greased glass tub.
Whisk eggs and cottage cheese together with taco spice. Stir in corn, black beans and diced tomato, mushroom, onion, spinach and capsicum.
Pour egg mixture over the sweet potato base.
Bake at 180°C for 20-25 minutes until golden and set.
Top with sliced avocado and salsa to serve.

meals.name: Mexican Bowl
method: Cook basmati rice per packet instructions.
Season diced chicken with cumin, garlic, onion powder, chilli and a squeeze of lime juice.
Pan grill or bake chicken until cooked through, then slice or dice.
Warm corn and black beans. Prep all fresh veg.
Serve rice in a bowl topped with chicken, corn, beans, avocado, salsa, Chobani and fresh veg.

meals.name: Vietnamese Salad Bowl
method: Cook vermicelli noodles per packet instructions, drain and rinse under cold water.
Season chicken and pan grill or bake until cooked through, then slice.
Make the dressing: loosen peanut butter with a dash of boiling water, then add soy sauce, lime juice, vinegar and a pinch of Truvia brown sugar.
Combine noodles, veg, herbs and sliced chicken in a bowl. Drizzle dressing over and toss to combine.

meals.name: Satay Beef
method: Cook basmati rice per packet instructions.
Heat a lightly sprayed pan over medium-high heat. Brown mince, breaking it up as it cooks. Add onion, capsicum and green beans and stir-fry until softened.
Mix soy sauce, peanut butter and red curry paste together. Reduce pan heat and stir sauce through.
Remove from heat and fold through Chobani to finish the sauce. Serve over rice.

meals.name: Hot Honey Beef

ingredients.name: Sweet potato
ingredients.note: raw weight; boil and mash or bake diced

method: Boil or bake sweet potato until soft, then mash or serve as chunks.
Heat a sprayed pan over medium-high. Brown mince, breaking it up. Add onion, capsicum and zucchini and cook until softened.
Stir in tomato paste and season with cumin, garlic and pepper. Add spinach and stir until wilted.
Plate mince over sweet potato. Top with Chobani, drizzle with honey and Sriracha, finish with chilli flakes.

meals.name: Mediterranean Spicy Beef
method: Cook basmati rice per packet instructions, or prepare mashed/roasted Spud Lite.
Heat oil in a pan over medium-high. Brown mince or sear steak strips. Add veg and cook until softened.
Stir in tomato paste, spices, chickpeas and a squeeze of lemon juice. Simmer 5-10 minutes. Alternatively, place everything in a baking dish, cover with foil and bake at 180°C for 30-40 minutes.
Serve topped with tzatziki and crumbled feta.

meals.name: Hummus Beef Bowl
method: Cook basmati rice per packet instructions.
Heat a sprayed pan and brown mince or sear beef strips until cooked through. Season to taste.
Serve over rice with fresh salad, a generous dollop of hummus and fresh mint and parsley.

meals.name: Greek Salad Bowl
method: Dice sweet potato, spray with olive oil and season with salt, pepper and garlic. Roast at 180°C for 25-30 minutes until golden.
Season chicken and pan grill or bake until cooked through, then slice.
Whisk dressing ingredients together: lemon juice, vinegar, olive oil, oregano, mint, garlic and chilli.
Toss salad veg with dressing. Serve alongside chicken and sweet potato topped with feta, olives and tzatziki.

meals.name: Thai Green Curry
method: Cook basmati rice per packet instructions.
Heat a sprayed pan over medium heat. Add curry paste and stir 1 minute until fragrant.
Add diced chicken and cook through. Add veg and stir-fry briefly.
Stir in light coconut cream and a splash of water if needed. Simmer 5 minutes until sauce coats the chicken. Serve over rice.

meals.name: Teriyaki Beef

ingredients.name: Extra lean beef stir fry strips

method: Cook basmati rice per packet instructions.
Heat oil in a pan over high heat and sear beef strips until browned. Remove and set aside.
Cook capsicum, onion and broccoli in the same pan until tender-crisp.
Return beef to the pan, add teriyaki sauce and toss to coat. Serve over rice.

meals.name: Sushi Bowl
method: Cook jasmine rice. Season with a splash of rice wine vinegar once cooked if desired.
Arrange rice in a bowl and top with tuna, edamame, sliced carrot, cucumber and spring onion.
Whisk mayo and soy sauce together and drizzle over. Serve with torn seaweed on the side.

meals.name: Thai Beef Salad

ingredients.name: Extra lean beef stir fry strips

method: Soak vermicelli in boiling water for 3-4 minutes, then drain and rinse under cold water.
Sear beef strips in a sprayed pan over high heat until cooked to your liking.
Whisk dressing: loosen peanut butter with boiling water, then stir in Thai curry paste, lime juice, honey, Sriracha, vinegar, chilli and herbs.
Arrange noodles and salad veg in a bowl. Top with beef and drizzle with dressing. Finish with crushed peanuts and spring onion.

meals.name: Creamy Pasta Salad
method: Cook pasta per packet instructions, drain and rinse under cold water to stop cooking.
Dice all veg small. Dice ham.
Combine cooled pasta, ham, veg, mayo and shredded cheese. Toss well. Serve chilled or at room temperature.

meals.name: Chicken & Rice — BBQ Pineapple (Lunch)
method: Cook basmati rice per packet instructions.
Heat a sprayed pan and cook diced capsicum and onion until softened. Add diced chicken and cook through.
Stir in BBQ sauce and pineapple and cook 1-2 more minutes. Lay cheese on top and allow to melt before serving over rice.

meals.name: Tandoori Chicken
method: Cook basmati rice per packet instructions.
Coat diced chicken in tandoori marinade and allow to rest while you prep the veg.
Heat garlic-infused oil spray in a pan over medium-high. Grill onion and capsicum until lightly charred. Add chicken and cook through, turning regularly.
Boil or microwave peas. Serve chicken and veg over rice, topped with tzatziki.

meals.name: Tuna Burger
method: Drain tuna well. Combine with egg, parmesan, corn, grated veg, breadcrumbs, pepper and parsley. Mix thoroughly.
Shape into patties and place on a lined baking tray.
Bake at 180°C for 30-40 minutes flipping halfway, or air fry at 180°C for 15-20 minutes, turning halfway, until golden.
Serve in burger thins with mayo, Sriracha and fresh leaves.

meals.name: Zucchini Bacon Slice
method: Grate zucchini, carrot and onion, then squeeze out excess moisture with a clean cloth or your hands.
Combine with eggs, cottage cheese, cheese, bacon, flour, baking powder and pepper. Mix until well combined.
Pour into a greased baking tray or divide into individual glass tubs.
Bake at 180°C for 30-40 minutes until golden and set through the centre.

meals.name: Roast Veg Salad
method: Dice pumpkin and beetroot, spray with oil and season with paprika, garlic, ginger and pepper. Roast at 180°C for 30-40 minutes.
Spray remaining veg and chickpeas with oil and roast on a separate tray for 20-30 minutes.
Season chicken and bake on a separate tray for 30-40 minutes at 180°C, then shred.
Toss all roasted veg together with spinach. Drizzle with lemon juice. Serve topped with hummus and fresh herbs.

meals.name: Broccoli Beef Buddah Bowl

ingredients.name: Extra lean beef stir fry strips

method: Bake or microwave diced sweet potato until tender.
Steam or stir-fry broccoli and carrot until just cooked.
Heat coconut oil in a pan over high heat and quickly sear beef strips until browned.
Mix dressing: coconut aminos or soy sauce with chilli, ginger, garlic and lime juice. Serve beef over sweet potato and veg, drizzle dressing over and top with cashews.

meals.name: Teriyaki Poke Bowl
method: Cook basmati rice per packet instructions.
Season and pan grill or bake chicken until cooked through, then slice. Cook edamame and corn.
Arrange rice in a bowl and top with chicken, edamame, corn, carrot and cucumber.
Drizzle teriyaki sauce over. Finish with spring onion and pickled ginger.

meals.name: Pesto Pasta
method: Cook pasta per packet instructions.
Season chicken and pan grill until cooked through, then slice. In the same pan, cook zucchini, cherry tomato and onion until softened.
Toss cooked pasta, chicken, veg and pesto together. Top with crumbled feta.

meals.name: Tuna Sweet Corn Pasta Salad
method: Cook pasta, drain and allow to cool.
Drain tuna and corn. Dice all veg small.
Whisk mayo, Dijon mustard and herbs together for the dressing.
Combine pasta, tuna, corn and veg. Stir through dressing. Fold in sliced avocado just before serving.

meals.name: Sweet Chilli Prawn Salad Bowl / Cold Rolls

ingredients.name: Rice noodles
ingredients.note: dry; or 40g basmati rice, or 4 rice paper wraps

method: Cook noodles or rice per packet instructions. For cold rolls: soak each rice paper sheet in warm water for 30 seconds until pliable.
Cook prawns in a lightly sprayed pan over medium-high heat until pink and cooked through.
For bowl: combine noodles or rice with prawns, mango, corn, avocado and veg. Mix mayo and sweet chilli sauce and drizzle over.
For cold rolls: fill each softened sheet with prawns and veg, roll tightly and serve with the mayo-sweet chilli dipping sauce.

meals.name: Beet Feta Walnut Salad
method: Cover couscous with boiling water (use roughly 1.5x the volume of couscous), season, cover and allow to absorb for 5 minutes. Fluff with a fork.
Season and pan grill or bake chicken until cooked through, then slice.
Whisk dressing: Dijon, balsamic, honey and a squeeze of lemon juice.
Combine couscous with salad veg. Top with chicken, walnuts, beetroot and feta. Drizzle with dressing.

meals.name: Sweet Chilli Tuna Salad
method: Cook basmati rice per packet instructions.
Drain tuna, corn and edamame. Mix mayo and sweet chilli sauce together.
Combine all salad ingredients and drizzle with dressing. Serve over rice.

meals.name: Sweet Sour Pork Bake Bowl (Lunch)
method: Add uncooked rice, stock, pork mince, sauces, onion, capsicum, pineapple and garlic to a glass tub. Stir to combine.
Bake at 180°C for 45-50 minutes, stirring halfway, until pork is cooked through and rice has absorbed the liquid.

meals.name: Creamy Chicken and Rice Bake Bowl (Lunch)
method: Add uncooked rice to the bottom of a glass tub. Add diced chicken, veg, sundried tomatoes and seasoning.
Mix light cooking cream and stock together and pour over to just cover the rice.
Bake at 180°C for 40 minutes until chicken is cooked through and liquid is absorbed.

meals.name: Chicken & Rice BBQ Pineapple (Lunch — Large)
method: Cook basmati rice per packet instructions.
Heat a sprayed pan. Cook diced capsicum and onion until softened. Add diced chicken and cook through.
Stir in BBQ sauce and pineapple and cook 1-2 minutes. Top with cheese and allow to melt. Serve over rice.

meals.name: Tzatziki Chicken Salad
method: Cook basmati rice per packet instructions.
Make tzatziki dressing: combine Chobani, grated cucumber, garlic, mint, dill, honey, lemon juice and pepper.
Season and pan grill or bake chicken until cooked through, then slice. Toss chicken through the dressing.
Serve over rice with fresh salad veg.

meals.name: Pesto Chicken Wrap
method: Warm the wrap in a dry pan or microwave for 20 seconds.
Spread pesto across the centre of the wrap.
Layer with sliced cooked chicken, tomato, spinach and crumbled feta.
Roll tightly. Can be toasted in a sandwich press for extra crunch.

meals.name: Mediterranean Beef Wrap
method: Season mince and pan cook in a lightly sprayed pan over medium-high heat until browned and cooked through.
Warm the wrap in a dry pan or microwave for 20 seconds.
Layer with cooked mince, fresh veg, tzatziki and crumbled feta.
Roll tightly. Can be toasted in a sandwich press for extra crunch.

meals.name: Turkey Cranberry Wrap
method: Warm the wrap in a dry pan or microwave for 20 seconds.
Spread cream cheese across the wrap.
Layer turkey breast down the centre and spoon over cranberry sauce.
Roll tightly. Can be toasted in a sandwich press for extra crunch.

meals.name: BBQ Beef Wrap

ingredients.name: Extra lean beef stir fry strips

method: Season beef strips and pan cook in a lightly sprayed pan over high heat until browned.
Warm the wrap in a dry pan or microwave for 20 seconds.
Layer beef, cheese, capsicum and onion across the wrap. Drizzle with BBQ sauce.
Roll tightly. Can be toasted in a sandwich press for extra crunch.

meals.name: Chicken Fajita Wrap
method: Season chicken and pan cook in a lightly sprayed pan until cooked through, then slice.
Warm the wrap in a dry pan or microwave for 20 seconds.
Layer chicken, cheese, salsa, sour cream and lettuce across the wrap.
Roll tightly. Can be toasted in a sandwich press for extra crunch.

meals.name: BBQ Chicken Wrap
method: Season chicken and pan cook in a lightly sprayed pan until cooked through, then slice.
Warm the wrap in a dry pan or microwave for 20 seconds.
Layer chicken, cheese, fresh veg and a drizzle of mayo and BBQ sauce across the wrap.
Roll tightly. Can be toasted in a sandwich press for extra crunch.

meals.name: Satay Chicken Wrap
method: Season chicken and pan cook in a lightly sprayed pan until cooked through, then slice.
Warm the wrap in a dry pan or microwave for 20 seconds.
Spread sweet chilli sauce across the wrap and layer chicken, coleslaw mix and crushed peanuts.
Roll tightly. Can be toasted in a sandwich press for extra crunch.

meals.name: Ham & Cheese Pizza Wrap
method: Warm the wrap in a dry pan or microwave for 20 seconds.
Spread pizza sauce across the wrap. Layer with ham, mozzarella, capsicum and spinach.
Fold in half or roll. Bake at 180°C for 5-8 minutes (or toast in a sandwich press) until cheese has melted.

meals.name: Teriyaki Tuna & Corn Wrap
method: Drain tuna and corn. Mix tuna with teriyaki sauce and mayo.
Warm the wrap in a dry pan or microwave for 20 seconds.
Layer the tuna mixture, corn, mozzarella and fresh veg across the wrap.
Roll tightly. Can be toasted in a sandwich press for extra crunch.

meals.name: Cheeseburger Wrap

ingredients.name: Extra lean beef stir fry strips

method: Season beef strips and pan cook in a lightly sprayed pan over high heat until browned.
Warm the wrap in a dry pan or microwave for 20 seconds.
Layer beef, cheese, pickles, lettuce and tomato across the wrap. Drizzle with tomato sauce and Dijon mustard.
Roll tightly. Toast in a sandwich press for extra crunch.

meals.name: Bagel Snack — Ham Cheese
method: Slice and toast the Abe's bagel.
Layer with light tasty cheese and deli sliced ham.

meals.name: Bagel Snack — Nutella
method: Slice and toast the Abe's bagel.
Spread Mayver's protein choc PB across both halves.

meals.name: Bagel Snack — Salmon Cream Cheese
method: Slice and toast the Abe's bagel.
Spread light cream cheese on both halves and layer smoked salmon on top.

meals.name: Bagel Snack — Strawberry Ricotta
method: Slice and toast the Abe's bagel.
Spread one half with light ricotta and the other with jam, then sandwich together.

meals.name: Bagel Snack — Honey PB
method: Slice and toast the Abe's bagel.
Spread with Mayver's protein vanilla PB and drizzle with honey.

meals.name: Wrap Snack — Ham Cheese
method: Lay the wrap flat.
Layer with ham, cheese, sliced tomato and spinach.
Roll up tightly. Optional: toast in a dry pan for 1-2 minutes per side.

meals.name: Wrap Snack — Pesto Chicken
method: Lay the wrap flat and spread with pesto.
Add sliced cooked chicken and crumbled feta.
Roll up tightly. Optional: toast in a dry pan for 1-2 minutes per side.

meals.name: Wrap Snack — Turkey Cranberry
method: Lay the wrap flat and spread with light cream cheese.
Layer turkey and spoon cranberry sauce down the centre.
Roll up tightly. Optional: toast in a dry pan for 1-2 minutes per side.

meals.name: Wrap Snack — Nutella
method: Lay the wrap flat.
Spread with Mayver's protein choc PB and a thin layer of cream cheese.
Roll up tightly and slice in half.

meals.name: Protein Yoghurt — Choc Berry
method: Spoon Yopro into a bowl.
Top with strawberries and drizzle Mayver's hazelnut cashew cacao spread across the top.

meals.name: Protein Yoghurt — Apple
method: Spoon Yopro into a bowl.
Warm canned apple briefly, spoon over the yoghurt, crumble Biscoff biscuits on top and drizzle with caramel syrup.

meals.name: Protein Yoghurt — Milo
method: Spoon Yopro into a bowl.
Slice banana over the yoghurt and sprinkle generously with Milo powder.

meals.name: Protein Yoghurt — Mango Coconut
method: Spoon Yopro into a bowl.
Top with mango, drizzle with caramel syrup and sprinkle with shredded coconut.

meals.name: Protein Yoghurt — White Choc Raspberry

ingredients.name: Noshu sugar free white choc chips

method: Spoon Yopro into a bowl.
Top with raspberries and Noshu sugar-free white choc chips.

meals.name: Protein Yoghurt — Snickers
method: Spoon Yopro into a bowl.
Chop dates, chocolate and peanuts, sprinkle over the yoghurt and drizzle with caramel syrup.

meals.name: Protein Yoghurt — Blueberry Choc
method: Spoon Yopro into a bowl.
Top with blueberries, scatter finely chopped chocolate over and drizzle with sugar-free choc syrup.

meals.name: Protein Yoghurt — Cranberry Pepita
method: Spoon Yopro into a bowl.
Sprinkle pepitas and cranberries across the top and drizzle with sugar-free choc syrup.

meals.name: Protein Yoghurt — Peach Coconut
method: Spoon Yopro into a bowl.
Top with drained peach slices and sprinkle generously with shredded coconut.

meals.name: Cheese & Crackers
method: Arrange Jatz crackers on a plate.
Top each with a slice of tasty cheese and a halved cherry tomato.

meals.name: Egg Muffins
method: Whisk eggs in a bowl, then whisk in cottage cheese until smooth.
Dice tomato, onion, mushroom and capsicum, and shred spinach. Mix into the egg mixture along with diced ham.
Season with paprika, oregano and pepper.
Lightly spray muffin cases with olive oil and divide the mixture between them.
Bake at 180°C for 20-25 minutes until golden and set through the centre.

meals.name: Protein Muffins — Banana
method: Mash banana in a bowl. Stir in protein powder, egg, baking powder and a pinch of cinnamon.
Add dashes of water as needed to reach a smooth batter consistency.
Lightly spray muffin cases with olive oil and spoon in the batter.
Bake at 170°C for 20-30 minutes until golden on top and cooked through the middle.

meals.name: Easy Bars — Noway

ingredients.name: Carmen's fruit and nut muesli bar

method: Pair a Noway collagen protein bar with a Carmen's fruit and nut muesli bar — a quick high-protein snack on the go.

meals.name: Easy Bars — Fibre Boost

ingredients.name: Carmen's fruit and nut muesli bar

method: Pair a Fibre Boost bar with a Carmen's fruit and nut muesli bar — a quick high-fibre snack on the go.

meals.name: Chicken Sweetcorn Patty

ingredients.name: Salsa
ingredients.note: or Ayam Light sweet chilli sauce

method: Grate zucchini and carrot, squeezing out excess moisture with a clean cloth.
Combine grated veg with chicken mince, egg, breadcrumbs, parmesan, corn, oregano, parsley and pepper.
Press the mixture into small patties on a lined baking tray sprayed with olive oil.
Bake at 180°C for 20-30 minutes, flipping halfway, or air fry until golden.
Serve with salsa (or Ayam Light sweet chilli sauce) and a dollop of fat-free mayo.

meals.name: Chickpea Cookie Dough
method: Drain and rinse chickpeas, then mash with a fork until smooth.
Stir in protein powder — the mixture should thicken into a dough. Add dashes of water or sugar-free caramel syrup if needed.
Fold through chopped dark chocolate.
Eat as is, or roll into balls and set in the fridge.

meals.name: Chickpea Choc Coconut Ball
method: Drain and rinse chickpeas, then mash with a fork until smooth.
Stir in protein powder, cocoa powder and shredded coconut. Add dashes of water until you reach a doughy consistency.
Roll into small balls and set in the fridge for 15-20 minutes before eating.

meals.name: Protein Ball — Choc Chip
method: Combine protein powder, oat flour and almond meal in a bowl.
Stir in sugar-free caramel syrup and dashes of water, kneading until you reach a doughy consistency.
Fold through chopped dark chocolate.
Eat as is, or roll into balls and set in the fridge.

meals.name: Apple Oat Muffin
method: Mix protein powder with a dash of water until you reach a thick batter consistency.
Stir in rolled oats, diced apple, honey, baking powder and a pinch of cinnamon, ginger and nutmeg.
Spoon into muffin cases or a glass tub. Sprinkle a few extra oats on top.
Bake at 180°C for 20-30 minutes until golden.

meals.name: Pumpkin Choc Chia Mousse
method: Steam or microwave pumpkin until very soft, then mash and allow to cool.
Stir in cocoa powder, protein powder and chia seeds. Adjust consistency with a dash of water — aim for a thick pudding.
Fold through finely chopped dark chocolate.
Refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight to allow the chia seeds to thicken.

meals.name: Mini Chocolate Rice Cakes

ingredients.name: Table of plenty mini chocolate rice cakes

method: Open the pack and enjoy one rice cake as a low-cal sweet hit.

meals.name: Biscoff Biscuits
method: Pair two Biscoff biscuits with a cup of tea or coffee.

meals.name: Kit Kat Mini

ingredients.name: Kit Kat mini (fun size from share pack)

method: Take one fun-size Kit Kat from a share pack.

meals.name: Twirl Mini

ingredients.name: Twirl mini (from individual wrapped share pack)

method: Unwrap one mini Twirl from an individually wrapped share pack.

meals.name: Mini Wafer Snack Pack
method: Open one individual wafer snack pack and enjoy.

meals.name: Yoghurt Bowl (Chobani) — Choc Berry

ingredients.name: Chobani light
ingredients.note: or Coles perform protein greek yoghurt

method: Spoon Chobani light into a bowl.
Top with strawberries and drizzle Mayver's hazelnut cashew cacao spread across the top.

meals.name: Yoghurt Bowl (Chobani) — Apple

ingredients.name: Chobani light
ingredients.note: or Coles perform protein greek yoghurt

method: Spoon Chobani light into a bowl.
Warm canned apple pie fruit briefly in the microwave, then spoon over the yoghurt.
Crumble Biscoff biscuits on top, drizzle with caramel syrup and sprinkle with cinnamon.

meals.name: Yoghurt Bowl (Chobani) — Milo

ingredients.name: Chobani light
ingredients.note: or Coles perform protein greek yoghurt

method: Spoon Chobani light into a bowl.
Sprinkle Milo powder and Milo protein cereal across the top.

meals.name: Yoghurt Bowl (Chobani) — Mango Coconut

ingredients.name: Chobani light
ingredients.note: or Coles perform protein greek yoghurt

method: Spoon Chobani light into a bowl.
Top with mango (use canned drained, or thaw frozen briefly).
Drizzle with caramel syrup and sprinkle with shredded coconut.

meals.name: Yoghurt Bowl (Chobani) — White Choc Raspberry

ingredients.name: Chobani light
ingredients.note: or Coles perform protein greek yoghurt

ingredients.name: Noshu sugar free white choc chips

method: Spoon Chobani light into a bowl.
Top with raspberries and Noshu sugar-free white choc chips.

meals.name: Yoghurt Bowl (Chobani) — Banana Caramel

ingredients.name: Chobani light
ingredients.note: or Coles perform protein greek yoghurt

method: Spoon Chobani light into a bowl.
Slice banana over the yoghurt.
Sprinkle with chopped peanuts and drizzle with caramel syrup.

meals.name: Yoghurt Bowl (Chobani) — Snickers

ingredients.name: Chobani light
ingredients.note: or Coles perform protein greek yoghurt

method: Spoon Chobani light into a bowl.
Chop Lindt chocolate and peanuts small.
Sprinkle chocolate and peanuts over the yoghurt and drizzle with caramel syrup.

meals.name: Yoghurt Bowl (Chobani) — Blueberry Choc

ingredients.name: Chobani light
ingredients.note: or Coles perform protein greek yoghurt

method: Spoon Chobani light into a bowl.
Top with blueberries.
Sprinkle finely chopped Lindt chocolate over and drizzle with sugar-free choc syrup.

meals.name: Yoghurt Bowl (Chobani) — Cranberry Pepita

ingredients.name: Chobani light
ingredients.note: or Coles perform protein greek yoghurt

method: Spoon Chobani light into a bowl.
Sprinkle pepitas and cranberries across the top.
Drizzle with sugar-free choc syrup.

meals.name: Protein Oats — Carrot Walnut
method: Cover oats with water and microwave for 90 seconds.
Stir through protein powder until smooth, adding a dash more water if needed.
Top with grated carrot and walnuts, drizzle with caramel syrup and finish with a pinch of cinnamon and nutmeg.

meals.name: Protein Oats — Strawberry Choc
method: Cover oats with water and microwave for 90 seconds.
Stir through protein powder until smooth, adding a dash more water if needed.
Top with sliced strawberries and chopped dark chocolate squares.

meals.name: Protein Oats — White Choc Raspberry

ingredients.name: Noshu sugar free white choc chips

method: Cover oats with water and microwave for 90 seconds.
Stir through protein powder until smooth, adding a dash more water if needed.
Top with raspberries and Noshu sugar-free white choc chips.

meals.name: Protein Oats — Apple Crumble
method: Cover oats with water and microwave for 90 seconds.
Stir through protein powder until smooth, adding a dash more water if needed.
Warm canned apple briefly, spoon over the oats, crumble Biscoff on top and drizzle with caramel syrup.

meals.name: Yoghurt Bowl (Yopro) — Choc Berry
method: Spoon Yopro into a bowl.
Top with strawberries and drizzle Mayver's hazelnut cashew cacao spread over the top.

meals.name: Yoghurt Bowl (Yopro) — Apple
method: Spoon Yopro into a bowl.
Warm canned apple briefly and spoon over the yoghurt.
Crumble Biscoff biscuits across the top, drizzle with caramel syrup and sprinkle with cinnamon.

meals.name: Yoghurt Bowl (Yopro) — Milo
method: Spoon Yopro into a bowl.
Slice banana over the yoghurt and sprinkle generously with Milo powder.

meals.name: Yoghurt Bowl (Yopro) — White Choc Raspberry

ingredients.name: Noshu sugar free white choc chips

method: Spoon Yopro into a bowl.
Top with raspberries and Noshu sugar-free white choc chips.

meals.name: Yoghurt Bowl (Yopro) — Banana Caramel
method: Spoon Yopro into a bowl.
Slice banana over the yoghurt.
Sprinkle with chopped peanuts and drizzle with caramel syrup.

meals.name: Yoghurt Bowl (Yopro) — Mclurry
method: Spoon Yopro into a bowl.
Scatter M&Ms across the top and drizzle with sugar-free choc syrup.

meals.name: Yoghurt Bowl (Yopro) — Tim Tam
method: Spoon Yopro into a bowl.
Crumble Tim Tams over the top.

meals.name: Rice Flour Protein Cake — Berry Choc Coconut

ingredients.name: Sugar free strawberry or choc syrup (Queens)

method: Cover rice flour with double the volume of boiling water, stirring quickly to avoid clumping. It should absorb into a paste.
Stir in protein powder and baking powder, adding dashes of cold water until you reach a thick cake batter consistency.
Fold strawberries (or raspberries) and chopped chocolate through the batter.
Microwave in 2-minute increments (4-5 minutes total works best), or bake at 180°C for 20-30 minutes.
Top the cooked cake with Yopro, a drizzle of sugar-free syrup and a sprinkle of shredded coconut.

meals.name: Rice Flour Protein Cake — Apple Honey Walnut
method: Cover rice flour with double the volume of boiling water, stirring quickly to avoid clumping. It should absorb into a paste.
Stir in protein powder and baking powder, adding dashes of cold water until you reach a thick cake batter consistency.
Fold diced apple and chopped walnuts through the batter.
Microwave in 2-minute increments (4-5 minutes total works best), or bake at 180°C for 20-30 minutes.
Drizzle the cooked cake with honey to finish.

meals.name: Rice Flour Protein Cake — Banana Caramel
method: Cover rice flour with double the volume of boiling water, stirring quickly to avoid clumping. It should absorb into a paste.
Stir in protein powder and baking powder, adding dashes of cold water until you reach a thick cake batter consistency.
Fold sliced banana through the batter.
Microwave in 2-minute increments (4-5 minutes total works best), or bake at 180°C for 20-30 minutes.
Top the cooked cake with peanut butter (or crushed peanuts) and a drizzle of caramel syrup.

meals.name: Banana Mug Brownie
method: Mash banana into a thick paste in a microwave-safe mug or glass tub.
Stir in protein powder, baking powder, cocoa powder and Yopro yoghurt. Add dashes of water to loosen if needed — aim for a thick brownie batter.
Fold half the chopped chocolate through the batter and reserve the rest for the top.
Microwave 2-3 minutes until cooked through but still fudgy. Scatter remaining chocolate over the warm brownie so it melts slightly.

meals.name: Weetabix Blondie
method: Crush Weetabix into a bowl and cover with hot water. Let it absorb fully.
Mash banana into the mixture and stir in protein powder. Add more water in dashes if needed until you reach cake batter consistency.
Pour into a microwave-safe glass tub. Top with Noshu choc chips or fold half through the batter.
Microwave 3-4 minutes, or air fry at 180°C for 6-8 minutes, until set.

meals.name: Sweet Wrap
method: Spread Mayver's hazelnut cashew cacao spread across the centre of the wrap.
Microwave the wrap for 30 seconds to warm and soften the spread.
Spoon Yopro yoghurt down the middle. Roll up and slice in half to serve.

meals.name: Oreo Ice Cream
method: Scoop Peter's sugar-free ice cream into a bowl.
Crush the Oreos and sprinkle over with soy protein crisps.

meals.name: Burger Bowl
method: Cut potato into wedges, pre-boil for 20 minutes, then season with garlic salt, paprika and oregano. Air fry or bake at 180°C until golden.
Season mince with cumin, pepper and oregano. Pan cook over medium-high heat until browned and cooked through.
Mix burger sauce: mayo, tomato sauce and Dijon.
Serve chips topped with mince, fresh veg and burger sauce.

meals.name: Bolognaise Spud/Pasta

ingredients.name: Spud Lite
ingredients.note: raw weight; or 35g spaghetti dry as alternative

method: If using pasta, cook per packet instructions. If using potato, bake whole or as chunks until cooked through.
Heat a sprayed pan over medium-high. Brown mince, then add grated onion, zucchini and carrot.
Add diced tomatoes and tomato paste with basil, oregano, garlic and thyme. Simmer 10-15 minutes until sauce thickens.
Serve over pasta or loaded onto potato. Top with shredded cheese.

meals.name: Chili Con Carne Bake
method: Brown mince in a pan over medium-high heat, breaking it up. Drain excess fat if needed.
Transfer to individual glass tubs. Add uncooked rice, beef stock, kidney beans, veg, diced tomatoes and seasoning. Stir to combine.
Bake at 180°C for 40 minutes. Add mozzarella in the last 10 minutes. Top with Chobani to serve.

meals.name: Gyros Bowl
method: Cut potato into chips. Pre-boil for 20 minutes, then season with garlic salt, paprika and oregano. Air fry at 180°C for 10 minutes or bake for 20 minutes until golden.
Season chicken and pan grill or bake until cooked through, then slice.
Serve chips topped with chicken, fresh salad, crumbled feta and a drizzle of sweet chilli sauce and dressing.

meals.name: Cajun Chicken Pasta
method: Cook pasta per packet instructions.
Season chicken generously with paprika, garlic, onion powder, pepper and oregano. Pan grill until cooked through and slightly charred, then slice.
In the same pan, cook capsicum, onion and mushroom until softened. Add light cream cheese and a splash of chicken stock to create a sauce, stirring until smooth.
Toss cooked pasta, chicken and sauce together. Adjust consistency with more stock if needed.

meals.name: Prawn Pad Thai
method: Soak noodles in boiling water per packet instructions, then drain.
Heat a sprayed pan or wok over high heat. Cook prawns until pink. Push to the side, crack in egg, scramble, then mix through. Add veg and stir-fry briefly.
Add noodles. Whisk together soy sauce, peanut butter, fish sauce, Sriracha, garlic, lime juice, vinegar and brown sugar and stir through.
Serve with lime wedges and extra Sriracha if desired.

meals.name: Chicken Burger Hawaiian
method: Pre-boil potato chips for 10 minutes, then season and bake at 180°C or air fry until golden.
Season chicken breast and pan grill or bake at 180°C until cooked through.
Assemble burger: bun base, chicken, BBQ sauce, pineapple, cheese, onion, lettuce and tomato.
Serve with the chips on the side.

meals.name: Bang Bang Chicken Bake
method: Dice chicken. In a glass tub, add uncooked rice. Mix stock, 10g Sriracha, 10g mayo, 20g Chobani, 10g sweet chilli sauce, paprika, chilli and lemon juice together and pour over the rice.
Add diced chicken and veg on top. Bake at 180°C for 40 minutes until chicken is cooked and rice has absorbed the liquid.
Mix bang bang drizzle sauce: remaining 5g Sriracha, 10g mayo, 20g Chobani and 10g sweet chilli sauce.
Top the cooked bowl with sliced avocado and spring onion, drizzle with the bang bang sauce.

meals.name: Korean Beef Bake
method: Brown mince in a pan first, breaking it up. Transfer to individual glass tubs.
Add uncooked rice, beef stock, soy sauce, stevia brown sugar, olive oil, ginger, garlic, chilli and veg. Stir to combine.
Bake at 180°C for 40 minutes until mince is cooked through and rice has absorbed the liquid.
Serve drizzled with Sriracha and mayo, and topped with sesame seeds and spring onion.

meals.name: Lemon Orzo
method: Season chicken and pan grill until golden and cooked through. Set aside and slice.
In the same pan, melt Nuttelex and sauté onion until soft. Add grated zucchini and toast the risoni for 1-2 minutes.

Add chicken stock, paprika, lemon zest and juice, thyme and pepper. Place chicken on top, cover with a lid and simmer on low for 8-10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until risoni is cooked and liquid absorbed.
Remove from heat, stir through cream cheese. Top with feta, mozzarella and parsley.

meals.name: Steak
method: Pre-boil potato cubes for 10-12 minutes until just tender, then season with salt, garlic and oil and bake at 180°C or air fry until golden.
Season steak generously with salt, pepper and garlic. Heat a well-oiled pan over very high heat.
Sear steak 2-3 minutes per side for medium, adjusting to your preference. Rest for 3-5 minutes before serving.
Sauté asparagus and mushroom in the same pan with a little olive oil. Serve alongside the steak and chips.

meals.name: Honey Lemon Chicken Bake
method: Dice chicken and potato. Place in glass tubs or a baking tray, spray with olive oil and season with paprika, garlic, celery salt, chilli and oregano. Bake at 180°C for 30 minutes.
Whisk together lemon juice, honey, garlic olive oil and Sriracha for the sauce.
Add veg and pour sauce over. Reduce heat to 160°C and bake a further 15-20 minutes.
Garnish with spring onion and parsley before serving.

meals.name: Steak Fajita Bowl

ingredients.name: Extra lean beef stir fry strips

method: Cook basmati rice per packet instructions.
Heat a sprayed pan over high heat. Sear beef strips until well browned. Set aside.
In the same pan, cook onion and capsicum until softened and lightly charred.
Return beef to the pan. Add corn, paprika, garlic, pepper and a squeeze of lime. Toss to combine and serve over rice with lime wedges.

meals.name: Butter Chicken Soup
method: Heat a saucepan over medium. Cook onion and zucchini until softened. Add garlic, ginger, turmeric and garam masala and stir for 1 minute.
Add diced chicken, pumpkin, cauliflower, diced tomatoes and stock. Simmer 20-25 minutes until chicken and veg are tender.
Stir through coconut cream. Use a stick blender to blend partially for a thicker texture, or fully for a smooth soup. Shred any larger pieces of chicken and stir back through.
Serve with toast and butter.

meals.name: Loaded Spud
method: Bake potato in the oven at 200°C for 45-60 minutes, or microwave until cooked through. Score and open up.
Pan cook diced chicken in a sprayed pan until cooked through.
Top potato with ham, chicken, beetroot, pineapple, cheese and a dollop of light sour cream. Garnish with spring onion and chives.

meals.name: Potato Bake Bowl
method: Pre-boil potato chunks until just starting to soften, about 10-12 minutes.
Divide into glass tubs or a baking tray. Add diced chicken, onion and mushroom.
Mix cooking cream, stock, sundried tomatoes and seasoning together and pour over. Top with shredded cheese.
Bake at 180°C for 30-40 minutes until chicken is cooked through, potato is tender and top is golden.

meals.name: Marry Me Chicken Bake Bowl
method: Add uncooked macaroni to a glass tub. Add diced chicken, onion, mushroom, sundried tomatoes and seasoning.
Mix cooking cream, stock and parmesan together and pour over to cover the pasta. Stir gently.
Bake at 180°C for 40 minutes until pasta is cooked and sauce is absorbed. Stir once halfway through.

meals.name: Mini Pizza (Chicken)

ingredients.name: English muffin
ingredients.note: or 1 Mission pocket pita as alternative

method: Pre-cook chicken breast and shred.
Split English muffins or use pita bases. Spread pizza sauce over each base.
Top with shredded chicken, capsicum, onion, tomato, mushroom, pineapple, a drizzle of BBQ sauce and cheese.
Bake at 180°C or air fry for 10 minutes until cheese is melted and base is golden.

meals.name: Potato Bake Bowl — Nandos
method: Pre-boil potato chunks until just starting to soften, about 10-12 minutes.
Divide into glass tubs or a baking tray. Add diced chicken, onion and capsicum.
Mix Nandos marinade and cream cheese together with paprika and garlic. Stir through the tub. Top with shredded cheese.
Bake at 180°C for 30-40 minutes until chicken is cooked through and top is golden.

meals.name: Satay Beef — Simple

ingredients.name: Extra lean beef stir fry strips

method: Cook basmati rice per packet instructions.
Heat a sprayed pan over medium-high. Sear beef strips until browned.
Add frozen veg and cook until heated through. Stir through satay sauce and toss to coat.
Serve over rice, topped with sesame seeds.

meals.name: Sweet Sour Pork Bake Bowl
method: Add uncooked rice to the bottom of glass tubs. Add pork mince, sauces, chicken stock, onion, capsicum, pineapple and garlic. Stir to combine.
Bake at 180°C for 45-50 minutes, stirring halfway, until pork is cooked through and liquid is absorbed.

meals.name: Creamy Chicken and Rice Bake Bowl
method: Add uncooked rice to the bottom of glass tubs. Add diced chicken, onion, mushroom, sundried tomatoes and seasoning.
Mix cooking cream, stock and parmesan together and pour over.
Bake at 180°C for 45-50 minutes, stirring halfway, until cooked and liquid is absorbed.

meals.name: Beef Ragu Papardelle — Slow Cooker
method: Heat a sprayed pan over high heat. Sear beef with garlic and pepper until well browned. Set aside.
Soften mushrooms, carrot and onion briefly in the same pan.
Transfer everything to the slow cooker. Add red wine, diced tomatoes, beef stock and herbs. Slow cook on low 6-8 hours or high 3-4 hours.
Shred beef once tender. Cook pasta per packet instructions. Serve ragu over pasta or potato, topped with parmesan.

meals.name: Chicken Stew — Slow Cooker
method: Sear seasoned chicken in a sprayed pan and set aside. Soften carrot, onion and celery briefly in the same pan.
Transfer to slow cooker with diced potato, stock, flour and bay leaf. Slow cook on low 6-8 hours or high 3-4 hours.
Add peas and cooking cream in the last 30 minutes. Remove bay leaf before serving.

meals.name: Broccoli Cheese Soup
method: Pan sear seasoned chicken in butter and set aside.
In the same pot, sauté onion until soft. Add broccoli, carrot, potato and stock. Bring to a boil and simmer 20-25 minutes until veg is soft.
Use a stick blender to blend until smooth. Stir in cooking cream, shredded cheese and shredded chicken.
Simmer a few more minutes until cheese is melted. Season to taste.

meals.name: Mexi Beef Chilli
method: Peel and boil sweet potato until tender, then mash.
Pan grill onion, capsicum and mushroom until softened. Add mince and cook until browned. Season with chilli powder, cumin, paprika and garlic.
Add diced tomatoes, black beans and corn. Simmer 10-15 minutes until sauce reduces.
Serve mince over mashed sweet potato, topped with Chobani and fresh coriander.

meals.name: Spring Roll Bowl — Sweet Chilli Chicken

ingredients.name: Tsp chinese 5 spice, minced ginger, garlic

method: Cook basmati rice per packet instructions.
Heat sesame oil in a pan over medium-high. Brown onion and chicken mince with Chinese five spice, minced ginger and garlic.
Add cabbage strips, grated carrot and a splash of lime juice. Cover with a lid and cook, stirring occasionally, until cabbage is soft.
Serve over rice, topped with sweet chilli sauce, crushed peanuts and spring onion.

meals.name: Cheeseburger Smash Wrap
method: Flatten mince directly onto the wrap and season with cumin, pepper and oregano.
Heat a sprayed pan over medium-high. Cook wrap meat-side down for 3-5 minutes until browned. Flip and cook 2 minutes on the wrap side.
Add toppings: lettuce, tomato, onion, pickles and cheese. Mix burger sauce (mayo, tomato sauce, Dijon) and drizzle over.
Fold and serve.

meals.name: Beef Stroganoff — Lower Sodium

ingredients.name: Extra lean stir fry beef strips

method: Cook pasta per packet instructions.
Heat a sprayed pan. Brown mushrooms, onion and zucchini. Add beef strips and brown well.
Mix Worcestershire, Dijon, stock, flour, pepper, paprika and garlic together and add to the pan. Simmer on low until sauce thickens.
Remove from heat and stir through cooking cream. Toss with cooked pasta and top with parsley.

meals.name: Chicken Pumpkin Curry — Slow Cooker
method: Add all ingredients (except coconut cream, chickpeas and spinach) to the slow cooker. Slice chicken breast in half to help it cook evenly.
Slow cook on low 6-8 hours or high 3-4 hours.
Add chickpeas, coconut cream and spinach in the last 30 minutes. Pull chicken out and shred, then return to the pot.

meals.name: Mexi Beef Chilli (with Tomato Paste)
method: Peel and boil sweet potato until tender, then mash.
Pan grill veg until softened. Add mince and cook until browned. Season with chilli powder, cumin, paprika and garlic.
Add tomato paste, diced tomatoes, black beans and corn. Simmer 10-15 minutes until sauce reduces.
Serve mince over mashed sweet potato, topped with Chobani and fresh coriander.

meals.name: Thai Coconut Lentil Curry — One Pot
method: Heat a deep pan and sauté onion, carrot, ginger and curry paste until fragrant.
Add stock, lime juice, coconut cream, soy sauce and red lentils. Add whole chicken breast. Bring to a boil then reduce to a simmer.
Cook 20-25 minutes until lentils are soft and chicken is cooked through. Pull chicken out, shred and return to the pot.
Add more stock if sauce is too thick. Serve topped with spring onion, coriander and chilli flakes.

meals.name: Fajita Beef Sweet Potato Skillet

ingredients.name: Extra lean stir fry beef strips OR extra lean mince

method: Cook sweet potato rice per packet instructions in the microwave.
Heat a sprayed pan over high heat. Cook beef with paprika, garlic and pepper until browned. Add onion, capsicum and mushroom and cook until softened.
Add corn, sweet potato rice and a drizzle of lime juice. Toss to combine.
Serve topped with avocado.

meals.name: Mediterranean Spicy Chicken

ingredients.name: Oregano, parsley, basil, pepper, paprika, chilli to taste

method: Cook basmati rice per packet instructions.
Season chicken with oregano, basil, paprika, pepper and chilli. Pan sear with olive oil until browned and cooked through, then slice.

In the same pan, cook eggplant, zucchini, capsicum and onion until softened. Add tomato paste, chickpeas and a squeeze of lemon. Simmer 5-10 minutes. Alternatively, bake everything together at 180°C for 30-40 minutes covered with foil.
Serve over rice with a dollop of tzatziki.

meals.name: Honey Soy Chicken

ingredients.name: Mince ginger, Chinese 5 spice, chilli powder
Mince ginger, Chinese 5 spice, chilli powder

method: Cook noodles or rice per packet instructions.
Heat a sprayed pan over medium-high. Cook diced chicken mince with ginger, five spice and chilli powder until browned. Add capsicum, zucchini and cabbage and stir-fry until softened.
Boil or microwave peas then add to the pan.
Stir through honey soy sauce (honey, soy sauce, lemon juice, ginger, five spice). Serve over noodles or rice.

meals.name: Parmi Naked
method: Boil and mash potato, or dice and bake until golden.
Slice chicken breast thinly. Season and bake at 180°C or air fry for 20-30 minutes, turning halfway, until cooked through.
Spread pizza sauce over chicken and top with cheese. Bake a further 10 minutes until melted and bubbling.
Steam frozen veg and serve alongside the chicken and potato.

meals.name: Beef Peanut Stir fry

ingredients.name: Extra lean beef stir fry strips
Tsp chinese 5 spice, minced ginger, chilli

method: Heat garlic-infused oil in a pan or wok over high heat. Brown beef strips well, then set aside.
Add veg to the same pan and stir-fry until just tender. Return beef.
Add soy sauce, lime juice, vinegar, five spice, ginger and chilli. Cover with a lid briefly to help steam the cabbage until soft.
Remove from heat. Whisk peanut butter and honey and drizzle over. Top with crushed peanuts and spring onion.

meals.name: Sausage Roll — Rice Paper
method: Brown onion and mince in a sprayed pan with garlic, cumin and pepper. Add grated veg and cook, covering with a lid, until softened. Stir through tomato paste and soy sauce. Remove from heat and cool slightly.
Soak rice paper sheets in warm water for 30 seconds until pliable.
Place filling along the lower third of each sheet. Fold sides in and roll up tightly. Brush with egg wash and spray lightly with oil.
Air fry at 180°C for 5-10 minutes each side until golden and crisp. Serve with tomato sauce.

meals.name: Crunchy Chicken Burger — Sweet Chilli
method: Slice chicken thinly. Dip in beaten egg then press firmly into crushed corn flakes.
Pan fry or air fry until golden and cooked through, approximately 5 minutes each side.
Assemble burger: bun, mayo, sweet chilli sauce, crunchy chicken and coleslaw.

meals.name: Prawn Marinara

ingredients.name: Tsp mince garlic, basil, parsley, chilli, pepper

method: Cook spaghetti per packet instructions.
Heat a sprayed pan over medium-high. Sauté garlic, onion, capsicum and zucchini until softened.
Add prawns and cook until pink. Stir in passata with basil, parsley, chilli and pepper. Simmer 5 minutes.
Serve over pasta topped with parmesan.

meals.name: Satay Chicken
method: Cook cauliflower rice per packet instructions in the microwave.
Heat a sprayed pan and cook diced chicken with ginger, garlic and seasoning until browned. Add onion, capsicum and broccoli and cook until softened.
Mix sauce (soy, peanut butter, lime juice, Sriracha, garlic, ginger, cumin, chilli, paprika, coriander) and stir through on low heat.
Remove from heat and fold through Chobani. Serve over cauliflower rice, topped with spring onion.

meals.name: Sweet Chilli Sticky Chicken

ingredients.name: Mince ginger, chinese 5 spice, chilli powder
Mince ginger, chinese 5 spice, chilli powder

method: Cook basmati rice per packet instructions.
Heat a sprayed pan over medium-high. Brown chicken mince with ginger, five spice and chilli powder. Add capsicum, zucchini, carrot and cabbage and stir-fry until softened.
Add corn and pineapple towards the end. Stir through sweet chilli sauce (honey, ketchup, Sriracha, dash of vinegar).
Serve over rice.

meals.name: Mini Pizza (Ham)
method: Split English muffins or use pita bases. Spread pizza sauce over each base.
Top with ham, pineapple, capsicum, onion, tomato, mushroom and cheese.
Bake at 180°C or air fry for 10 minutes until cheese is melted and base is golden.

meals.name: Massaman Beef Curry — Slow Cooker

ingredients.name: Extra lean stir fry beef strips
Cinnamon, lime juice, chilli, coriander, thai basil

method: Add curry paste, coconut cream, diced tomatoes, carrot, onion, potato and beef to the slow cooker. Season with cinnamon, lime juice, chilli and herbs. Add lime leaf.
Slow cook on low for 6-8 hours or high for 3-4 hours. Add capsicum and spinach halfway through.
Remove lime leaf before serving. Serve over cauliflower rice topped with crushed peanuts and coconut yoghurt.

meals.name: Hot Honey Beef
method: Peel and boil sweet potato until tender, then mash, or dice and air fry/bake until golden.
Heat a sprayed pan over medium-high. Cook onion, capsicum and zucchini until softened. Add mince and brown, breaking it up.
Stir in tomato paste, cumin, garlic and pepper. Add spinach and stir until wilted.
Plate over sweet potato. Top with Chobani, drizzle with honey and Sriracha, finish with chilli flakes.

meals.name: Creamy Pumpkin Pasta
method: Cook pasta per packet instructions. Reserve a splash of pasta water before draining.
Cook pumpkin until very soft (steam or microwave). Blend pumpkin, cannellini beans, coconut cream and protein powder until completely smooth.
Pan cook cherry tomatoes, mushrooms, onion and cabbage in a sprayed pan until softened.
Toss cooked pasta and veg through the sauce. Adjust consistency with pasta water if needed.

meals.name: Prawn Fried Rice
method: Cook and cool rice. Day-old rice works best as it fries without clumping.
Heat a sprayed pan or wok over high heat. Stir-fry prawns and veg together until cooked.
Push everything to the side, crack in egg, scramble, then mix through the pan.
Add rice and toss everything together. Stir through curry paste, soy sauce and fish sauce. Top with Sriracha.

meals.name: Garlic Prawns Pasta
method: Cook spaghetti per packet instructions.
Melt butter in a pan over medium heat. Cook onion and garlic until soft and fragrant.
Add prawns and cook until pink. Add lemon juice, cooking cream and parsley. Simmer 2-3 minutes until sauce reduces slightly.
Add peas and stir through. Toss with cooked pasta.

meals.name: Sweet Chilli Smash Wrap
method: Flatten chicken mince directly onto the wrap. Add coriander and mint.
Heat a sprayed pan over medium-high. Cook wrap chicken-side down for 3-5 minutes until browned. Flip and cook 2 minutes on the wrap side.
Top with carrot, lettuce, red onion, coriander, mint, sweet chilli sauce and peanuts. Fold and serve.

meals.name: Greek Smash Wrap
method: Flatten mince directly onto the wrap and season with oregano and pepper.
Heat a sprayed pan over medium-high. Cook wrap mince-side down for 3-5 minutes, then flip and cook 2 minutes.
Add toppings: tomato, cucumber, red onion, lettuce, tzatziki, sweet chilli sauce and crumbled feta. Fold and serve.

meals.name: BBQ Beef Smash Wrap
method: Flatten mince directly onto the wrap and season with paprika, garlic and onion powder.
Heat a sprayed pan over medium-high. Cook wrap mince-side down for 3-5 minutes, then flip and cook 2 minutes.
Add pineapple, mayo and BBQ sauce. Fold and serve.

meals.name: Prawn Tortilla
method: Cook prawns in a sprayed pan over medium-high until pink. Drizzle with lime juice and season.
Warm tortilla briefly in a dry pan.
Top with corn, avocado, coleslaw, prawns and a dollop of sour cream and coriander. Fold and serve.

meals.name: Creamy Chicken Mushroom Soup
method: Melt butter in a large saucepan over medium heat. Cook mushrooms, onion, carrot and celery until softened. Season with garlic, thyme, pepper and parsley.
Stir in flour and cook for 1 minute. Gradually pour in chicken stock, stirring constantly. Bring to a simmer.
Cook 15-20 minutes, then add cooking cream and shredded chicken (pre-grilled or boiled).
Simmer a further 10 minutes until the soup thickens. Season to taste.

meals.name: Beef Stew — Slow Cooker

ingredients.name: Extra lean stir fry beef strips

method: Brown beef strips in a sprayed pan with garlic, pepper and herbs. Set aside.
Add beef, carrot, onion, celery, tomato paste, diced potato, stock and diced tomatoes to the slow cooker.
Slow cook on low 6-8 hours or high 3-4 hours. Add peas and corn in the last 30 minutes.

meals.name: Mexican Potato Bake

ingredients.name: Spud Lite — pre boil chunks to soften

method: Pre-boil potato chunks until just starting to soften, about 10-12 minutes.
Brown mince in a pan, then add onion, capsicum and zucchini and cook until softened. Stir through salsa.
Layer potato and mince mixture in a glass tub or baking dish. Top with shredded cheese.
Bake at 180°C for 20-30 minutes if pre-cooked, or 40-50 minutes if from raw. Top with sour cream to serve.

meals.name: Carbonara — Lower Cal
method: Cook pasta per packet instructions.
Pan cook bacon with onion and mushroom until golden. Season with garlic, pepper and parsley.
Add cream cheese and a splash of stock to the pan. Stir until smooth and creamy, adding more stock as needed.
Toss through cooked pasta. Top with parmesan.

meals.name: Lemon Feta Cous Cous Chicken
method: Pour just enough boiling water over couscous to cover. Cover and allow to absorb for 5 minutes. Fluff with a fork, season and drizzle with lemon juice.
Season chicken with garlic, oregano, parsley and pepper. Pan grill or bake until cooked through.
Roast or pan fry veg until tender.
Serve couscous topped with chicken and veg, crumbled feta and an extra squeeze of lemon.

meals.name: Tuna Mornay — White Sauce Potato Bake
method: Make white sauce: melt Nutelex in a saucepan over medium heat. Add flour and stir to form a paste. Gradually whisk in milk and stock, bring to a simmer and stir constantly until thickened, about 5-10 minutes. Stir in mozzarella and season.
Microwave or boil sliced potato until just softened.
Layer potato, drained tuna and veg in a baking dish. Pour white sauce over evenly. Top with breadcrumbs and parmesan.
Bake at 180°C for 20-30 minutes until golden on top.
